examples: The neighborhood has changed completely over the past decade.
این محله در طول دهه گذشته به‌کلی تغییر کرده است.
She has worked as a nurse for nearly a decade now.
او نزدیک به یک دهه است که به‌عنوان پرستار کار می‌کند.
Technology from just one decade ago already feels outdated today.
فناوری مربوط به فقط یک دهه پیش امروز دیگر قدیمی به نظر می‌رسد.
miniContext: A decade is a span of ten years, long enough to notice real change in a person, a city, or a technology. Over the last decade, smartphones have changed how people communicate, shop, and even date. A musician's sound often shifts noticeably from one decade to the next. Looking back a decade can feel surprising, since changes that seemed gradual at the time add up to something huge.

examples: Without her glasses, her vision becomes blurry within a few feet.
بدون عینک، دید او در فاصله چند متری محو می‌شود.
The company's new vision focuses on sustainability rather than rapid growth.
چشم‌انداز جدید شرکت به‌جای رشد سریع، بر پایداری تمرکز دارد.
The architect shared her vision for a park that would float above the river.
معمار چشم‌انداز خود را برای پارکی که بالای رودخانه شناور باشد، به اشتراک گذاشت.
miniContext: Vision can mean the physical ability to see, or a mental picture of what the future could look like. Regular eye exams help doctors catch problems with vision before they become serious. A company's vision statement is supposed to guide every major decision it makes. Great leaders often share a clear vision that makes other people want to follow them.

examples: Only a small minority of students failed the final exam this semester.
فقط یک اقلیت کوچک از دانش‌آموزان این ترم در امتحان نهایی مردود شدند.
The policy was designed to protect the rights of every minority group in the country.
این سیاست برای حفاظت از حقوق هر گروه اقلیت در کشور طراحی شده بود.
In the vote, supporters of the plan were clearly in the minority.
در رأی‌گیری، حامیان این طرح به‌طور واضح در اقلیت بودند.
miniContext: A minority is a smaller part of a group, especially when compared to the majority. In many countries, protecting the rights of every minority community is written directly into the constitution. During the vote, those opposed to the new rule were a small minority. Historians often study how a minority opinion can eventually grow into mainstream belief over time.

examples: Tourists lined the street, hoping to catch a glimpse of the royal procession.
گردشگران در خیابان صف کشیده بودند به امید اینکه نگاهی کوتاه به رژه سلطنتی بیندازند.
Through the open curtain, I got a glimpse of the surprise party being set up.
از پشت پرده نیمه‌باز، نگاهی کوتاه به برپایی جشن سورپرایز انداختم.
The documentary offers a rare glimpse into the daily life of deep-sea fishermen.
این مستند نگاهی کوتاه و کمیاب به زندگی روزمره ماهیگیران اعماق دریا ارائه می‌دهد.
miniContext: A glimpse is a brief, often incomplete look at something. Commuters rushing through the station might catch only a glimpse of the street performer before the train arrives. The trailer gave fans just a glimpse of the movie's ending, leaving them desperate for more. Old family photographs offer a glimpse into a way of life that no longer exists.

examples: It seemed absurd to cancel the picnic just because of one small cloud.
به نظر پوچ و غیرمنطقی می‌رسید که فقط به خاطر یک ابر کوچک، پیک‌نیک را لغو کنیم.
He made an absurd claim that he had never once told a lie in his life.
او ادعای پوچی مطرح کرد که در طول زندگی‌اش هرگز حتی یک دروغ نگفته است.
The price of the hotel room was absurd compared to similar places nearby.
قیمت اتاق هتل در مقایسه با مکان‌های مشابه نزدیک، غیرمنطقی و پوچ بود.
miniContext: Something absurd is so illogical or ridiculous that it almost seems like a joke. It felt absurd to wait three hours for a table at a restaurant that wasn't even that good. Critics called the new tax rule absurd because it punished exactly the behavior it was supposed to encourage. Comedy often relies on absurd situations, like a serious businessman accidentally wearing mismatched shoes to a major meeting.

examples: Frequent travelers often know which airlines offer the most comfortable seats.
مسافران مکرر معمولاً می‌دانند کدام شرکت‌های هواپیمایی صندلی‌های راحت‌تری دارند.
There have been frequent power outages in the neighborhood this summer.
این تابستان قطعی‌های برق مکرری در این محله اتفاق افتاده است.
The two old friends frequent the same small café every Saturday morning.
آن دو دوست قدیمی هر شنبه صبح به همان کافه کوچک رفت‌وآمد مکرر دارند.
miniContext: Frequent describes something that happens often, over and over, within a short span of time. Frequent flyers often collect enough miles for a free vacation every couple of years. The city installed new traffic lights after frequent accidents at the intersection. As children, my brother and I used to frequent the same comic book shop every single weekend.

examples: Please don't hesitate to call me if you need anything during the trip.
لطفاً اگر در طول سفر به چیزی نیاز داشتی، بدون تردید با من تماس بگیر.
She began to hesitate at the edge of the diving board, unsure if she was ready.
او کنار تخته شیرجه شروع به تردید کرد، چون مطمئن نبود آماده است یا نه.
Investors hesitated to put money into the startup after the founder's sudden resignation.
سرمایه‌گذاران بعد از استعفای ناگهانی بنیان‌گذار، برای سرمایه‌گذاری در آن استارتاپ تردید کردند.
miniContext: To hesitate means to pause before acting, usually because of doubt or nervousness. A new driver might hesitate at a busy intersection, unsure exactly when it's safe to go. Negotiators are trained not to hesitate too long, since silence can be read as weakness. She didn't hesitate for even a second before diving in to help the drowning swimmer.

examples: He spent his retirement in a solitary cabin deep in the woods.
او دوران بازنشستگی‌اش را در یک کلبه منزوی و دورافتاده در دل جنگل گذراند.
A solitary figure stood at the end of the empty pier, watching the waves.
یک شخص تنها در انتهای اسکله خالی ایستاده بود و موج‌ها را تماشا می‌کرد.
Some animals, like certain owls, prefer a solitary lifestyle rather than living in groups.
برخی حیوانات، مانند بعضی گونه‌های جغد، به‌جای زندگی گروهی سبک زندگی منزوی را ترجیح می‌دهند.
miniContext: Solitary describes being alone, whether by choice or circumstance. A lighthouse keeper's solitary life once meant months without seeing another person. Some writers prefer a solitary routine, working alone in silence for hours at a time. Even in a crowded city, it's possible to feel strangely solitary if you don't know anyone around you.

examples: The two neighbors have been in conflict over the fence for years.
آن دو همسایه سال‌هاست بر سر حصار با هم درگیری دارند.
Her work schedule began to conflict with her evening classes at the university.
برنامه کاری او با کلاس‌های شبانه‌اش در دانشگاه تعارض پیدا کرد.
The novel explores the inner conflict of a soldier torn between duty and family.
این رمان تعارض درونی سربازی را بررسی می‌کند که بین وظیفه و خانواده گیر کرده است.
miniContext: Conflict is a serious disagreement or struggle between people, groups, or even ideas within one person. Long-standing conflict between the two countries has made trade negotiations extremely difficult. A good story usually needs some kind of conflict to keep readers interested. Her sense of duty was in conflict with her desire to spend more time with her children.

examples: A recent study found that most adults don't get enough sleep.
یک مطالعه اخیر نشان داد که بیشتر بزرگسالان خواب کافی ندارند.
In recent years, more people have started working from home.
در سال‌های اخیر، افراد بیشتری شروع به کار کردن از خانه کرده‌اند.
Her most recent novel received glowing reviews from critics across the country.
اخیرترین رمان او از سوی منتقدان سراسر کشور با نظرات مثبت فراوان همراه بود.
miniContext: Recent describes something that happened not long ago. A recent survey revealed that most office workers want more flexibility in their schedules. In recent months, the price of basic groceries has risen noticeably. His most recent album sounds completely different from the music he released a decade earlier.

examples: The detective needed more evidence before making an arrest.
کارآگاه قبل از بازداشت به شواهد بیشتری نیاز داشت.
There is strong evidence that regular exercise improves mental health.
شواهد قوی‌ای وجود دارد که ورزش منظم سلامت روان را بهبود می‌بخشد.
The old photographs served as evidence that the building once had a different design.
عکس‌های قدیمی به‌عنوان شواهدی بودند که آن ساختمان زمانی طرحی متفاوت داشته است.
miniContext: Evidence is information or proof that supports a claim or helps answer a question. Detectives collect physical evidence, like fingerprints and fibers, before forming any theory about a crime. Scientific evidence from hundreds of studies supports the link between smoking and lung disease. Without solid evidence, even a convincing story may not hold up in court.

examples: She prefers reading fiction over nonfiction because she loves getting lost in a story.
او داستان تخیلی را به کتاب‌های غیرداستانی ترجیح می‌دهد چون عاشق گم شدن در یک داستان است.
The author is best known for writing science fiction set on distant planets.
این نویسنده بیشتر به خاطر نوشتن داستان‌های علمی‌تخیلی که در سیاره‌های دوردست می‌گذرند شناخته می‌شود.
Despite the rumors, his connection to the scandal turned out to be pure fiction.
با وجود شایعات، ارتباط او با آن رسوایی در نهایت محض تخیل و دروغ بود.
miniContext: Fiction refers to stories that come from imagination rather than real events. Many readers turn to fiction as an escape from the stress of daily life. Historical fiction blends real events with invented characters to bring the past to life. Despite sounding convincing, the rumor about the company's bankruptcy turned out to be complete fiction.
